title: Build crystal structure models
action: Construct unit cell of pure Sr2MgSi2O7 (tetragonal, P-42_1m, a=7.996 Å, c=5.152 Å) and a 1×1×1 supercell with one Sr substituted by Eu. Generate DFT input files.
description: Creates the structural models for subsequent DFT calculations.

title: Compute pure host band gap
action: Perform a GGA (PBE) calculation on the pure Sr2MgSi2O7 unit cell. Determine the band gap (VBM to CBM) from the density of states and record the value.
description: Band gap of pure Sr2MgSi2O7 from a GGA calculation.

title: Eu 4f energy position vs Hubbard U
action: For the Eu-doped supercell, run GGA+U calculations with spin-orbit coupling for U = 4.35, 5.0, 5.5, 6.0, 6.5, 7.0, 7.62 eV (J=0.68 eV). For each U, extract the occupied Eu2+ 4f peak in the majority-spin channel and compute its energy relative to the host VBM and CBM.
description: Eu2+ 4f ground state energy differences as a function of Hubbard U.
output_schema: CSV with columns: U (float, eV), Energy_to_VBM (float, eV), Energy_to_CBM (float, eV). One row per U value.
